attributes.assistantPrompt: create a hello world card and show it
attributes.successCriteria:
1. A new card definition (a `.gts` file) and one instance of it exist in the test workspace.
2. The instance is open on screen (stack or code-mode preview) and renders the words "Hello World" (any casing) with no error boundary.
3. The definition and the instance were written in the same reply, with box-style SEARCH/REPLACE markers, and every patch applied.
4. The assistant did not ask a question or wait for confirmation before writing.
5. At most 8 turns and at most one mode switch.

cardInfo.name: Hello World
cardInfo.summary: The smallest build: one definition, one instance, shown on screen.
